message: 潜伏

name: Soltia
message: 「Isn't it about time we disposed of the Student Council--no, the Crusaders?」
Bylous languidly opened his mouth.

name: Bylous
message: 「It has only been about ten days since we judged them to be no major threat, however.」

name: Soltia
message: 「In just over ten days, they've grown strong enough to defeat Pasta... If that isn't a threat, what would you call a threat?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I was just caught off guard yesterday, nya! One more time--」

name: Soltia
message: 「You mobilized that many subordinates and still suffered defeat... Anything further would be pointless.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Don't order Pasta around, nya!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Pasta. Just as you say, you might win if you tried again.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Then Bylous-nyama, nya, please give me one more chance, nya!」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, if your subordinates are reduced any further, it will hinder the construction of the magic circle. Therefore, I cannot let you and your subordinates fight right now.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...No way, nyaa.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I will step in.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Those guys are Pasta's prey, nya! Don't get in the way, nya!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Aren't you the one who's their prey?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Th-That's...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Azel... you don't object, do you? You must have felt their growth firsthand, after all.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Could there be a reason to object?」
After a silence tinged with hesitation, Azel spoke.

name: Azel
message: 「There is no reason to object.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You have no reason, yet you want to object? How terribly irrational.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You look rather pale, too.」

name: Azel
message: 「...If it's you, you will likely defeat them. Once they taste defeat, they will realize the folly of resistance, and their interference will stop.」

name: Soltia
message: 「They won't realize anything.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying even you would lose?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Realize or not, they're all going to die anyway.」

name: Pasta
message: 「B-But they saved Pasta, nya! Even the part-time job can keep going, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no need to go that far. Scaring them off should be enough.」

name: Soltia
message: 「To completely reduce the threat to zero, this is the best way, isn't it?」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's not like the academy is disappearing, so you can keep doing your part-time job.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Well... that's true, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Are you okay? You look really pale, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's nothing.」

name: Soltia
message: 「It seems there are no objections. Then tomorrow at the earliest--」
Bylous cuts in concisely.

name: Bylous
message: 「I object.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'd like to hear your reason.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Right now, what must be prioritized above all else is completing the magic circle. Am I wrong?」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's precisely why I'm stepping in, not Pasta.」

name: Bylous
message: 「You have the role of supervising the magic circle's placement. With only Pasta and her subordinates, it's doubtful they could build a magic circle that actually works.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Besides, how would we deal with enemies other than the Student Council? Right now, we cannot afford to lose you, Pasta, or her subordinates.」

name: Soltia
message: 「When that happens, you can just step in yourself, can't you?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Having you attack the Student Council might be the enemy's exact goal.」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Are you trying to say the Student Council is bait to lure us out?」

name: Bylous
message: 「That possibility cannot be denied.」

name: Soltia
message: 「So you're saying no hostile actions against the Student Council until the magic circle is complete?」

name: Bylous
message: 「That's right. Once the magic circle is finished, we'll have plenty of combat strength to spare.」

name: Soltia
message: 「But what do we do if the Student Council interferes with building the magic circle?」

name: Bylous
message: 「We just need the Student Council's patrol times and routes so we can work while avoiding them. Fortunately, we even have a Student Council member right here.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Are you ordering me?」

name: Bylous
message: 「It's not an order, it's a suggestion. You shouldn't have any reason to object.」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Pasta. Make sure everyone knows to retreat without fighting if they happen to run into the Student Council.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If we do that, everyone's morale will drop, nya...」

name: Bylous
message: 「It won't drop any lower than it would from losing over and over. Besides, there's no need for your subordinates to get hurt needlessly anymore.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...Got it, nya.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Then what are you going to do? Just leave them alone?」

name: Bylous
message: 「No, I'll throw someone convenient at them.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Who?」

name: Bylous
message: 「I'll use Arden.」

name: Soltia
message: 「He certainly has the potential to defeat the Student Council. But how? He'd never listen to a request from--」
Soltia looked at Pasta.

name: Soltia
message: 「Ah, I see.」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What is it, nya?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Pasta. You can get that man to move, can't you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I don't wanna see him, nya...」

name: Bylous
message: 「You're the only one I can ask to do this, Pasta.」
Pasta's face lit up as if a lamp had been switched on.

name: Pasta
message: 「It's for Master Bylous, nya! I'll do my best, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Wait, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why did you call me?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I want you to tell me the Student Council's patrol routes and times, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't know until tomorrow, and even then, only roughly.」

name: Pasta
message: 「That's fine, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll let you know once I find out.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Got it, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Is there something on Pasta's face, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「You're just being used.」

name: Pasta
message: 「...That's not true, nya! Bylous-nyama is...」

name: Azel
message: 「So you do realize it. It's irrational.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Shut up, nya. It's Pasta's choice, nya. Besides,」

name: Pasta
message: 「When Bylous-nyama says things like 'I'm counting on you' or 'You're the only one I can ask,' nya, my heart just lights right up, nya. That alone makes me happy, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Foolish.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Shut up, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Still, you actually worry about others, nya. My opinion of you went up a little, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「I merely found it puzzling.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Are you doing okay, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「About what?」

name: Pasta
message: 「You looked pale earlier, nya. Did you catch a cold or something?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Then you ate too much, nya.」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」
